# Pull Request

## Type

Select exactly one type. A maintainer applies the matching `type:*` label.

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Documentation only
- [ ] Code refactoring
- [ ] Maintenance or tooling
- [ ] Breaking change

| Command | Result |
| --- | --- |

## Checklist

- [ ] The linked issue is approved with `status:approved`.
- [ ] I assigned myself to the issue and commented with my plan.
- [ ] I worked from a branch in my fork.
- [ ] I selected exactly one PR type.
- [ ] Repository artifacts and metadata are in English.
- [ ] This PR has a focused scope.
- [ ] Verification lists every test or check with its exact command and result.
- [ ] Documentation is updated when the behavior changes.
- [ ] No credentials, personal data, or private operational details are included.
- [ ] Security details are not disclosed publicly.
- [ ] Commits use Conventional Commits in English.
- [ ] Commits have no `Co-Authored-By` or AI attribution trailers.
